notes.title: Wheatflour Wonderland
notes.content: [h2]Wheatflower Wonderland DLC is available NOW![/h2][p][/p][p]Welcome to Wheatflour Wonderland, home of the Wheatflour Fairy, Cogimyun![/p][p]It's up to you to help Cogimyun be brave, and awaken her sleeping world. If you can find the Wheatflour Guardians together, who knows what will happen next...[/p][p]Craft powerful wands, discover the secrets of beautiful gemstones, and transform into your most magical self – or perhaps a supercute critter.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45303325/dd68e4bb7154f3989698222e77f7ccc11b1677b5.png"][/img][/p][p]♡ Befriend Cogimyun! Unlock 35 friendship levels that include fantastic companion abilities and her own furniture set [/p][p]♡ Uncover the story of the missing [b]Wheatflour Guardians[/b] and help Cogimyun return ancient powers to the world[/p][p]♡ Craft fantastic [b]wands[/b] out of beautiful gemstones that let you [b]cast magic[/b] and [b]transform[/b] [/p][p]♡ Use magic throughout the world to activate lamps, break through barriers, open chests, and infuse stained glass with power[/p][p]♡ Find ten new Wheatflour critters – and unlock the ability to transform into them![/p][p]♡ When Cogimyun accidentally creates her brother, [b]Cogimyon[/b], she paves the way for a new magical mini-game[/p][p]♡ Cogimyun’s pet tempura shrimp [b]Ebi Fry[/b] is missing! Find him, then find him again and again in a decorator’s dream mini-game[/p][p]♡ Become a stick! (And more)[/p][p]♡ Meet the [b]Grand Flowl[/b], special residents of Wheatflour Wonderland that will help (or not) you along your way[/p][p]♡ Find collectible [b]Wheathearts[/b] hidden throughout the largest world since the game’s launch[/p][p]♡ Discover new cooking and crafting opportunities that let you [b]customize[/b] your Wheatflour wear like never before[/p][p]♡ Nurture the new [b]Wheatflower[/b] and discover the [b]glitter[/b] effect, bringing a bright sparkle to your gardens[/p][p]♡ Ever wanted to play [b]hide and seek[/b] with your friend? What about when they can turn into a palm tree? [/p][p]♡ Customize your own magical look with different color palettes, wands, and new emotes[/p][p][/p][h3]Visit Wheatflower Wonderland today and join a whimsical adventure![/h3][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45303325/c30d905b59f6b9b86bc1d1fb2a0866c66b4b3ff6.png"][/img][/h3]

tags.feature: ♡ Befriend Cogimyun! Unlock 35 friendship levels that include fantastic companion abilities and her own furniture set
♡ Uncover the story of the missing Wheatflour Guardians and help Cogimyun return ancient powers to the world
♡ Craft fantastic wands out of beautiful gemstones that let you cast magic and transform
♡ Use magic throughout the world to activate lamps, break through barriers, open chests, and infuse stained glass with power
♡ Find ten new Wheatflour critters – and unlock the ability to transform into them!
♡ When Cogimyun accidentally creates her brother, Cogimyon, she paves the way for a new magical mini-game
♡ Cogimyun’s pet tempura shrimp Ebi Fry is missing! Find him, then find him again and again in a decorator’s dream mini-game
♡ Meet the Grand Flowl, special residents of Wheatflour Wonderland that will help (or not) you along your way
♡ Find collectible Wheathearts hidden throughout the largest world since the game’s launch
♡ Discover new cooking and crafting opportunities that let you customize your Wheatflour wear like never before
♡ Nurture the new Wheatflower and discover the glitter effect, bringing a bright sparkle to your gardens
♡ Ever wanted to play hide and seek with your friend? What about when they can turn into a palm tree?
♡ Customize your own magical look with different color palettes, wands, and new emotes

notes.title: Update Notes for February 12th
notes.content:
Hello friends! Our newest Steam patch is now available. Here are the bugs we fixed:
[list]
[*] Cancel button in dialogue works more consistently
[*] UI in windowed mode is now more easily resizable
[*] Missing items from the Deluxe Event Bundle are being granted to players! If you have already unlocked this bundle, you will receive these items upon starting a session. If you have not unlocked the Deluxe Event Bundle, you will get all items at the same time once the quest requirements are reached.
[*] Fish Tales weekly quest - Players should be able to catch fish in Mount Hothead as intended
[/list]

Happy exploring!

notes.title: Update Notes for February 6th
notes.content:
Hi Steam players! We have another update for you to download full of fixes and quest improvements, including;
[list]
[*] The Dye Station is no longer usable by multiplayer guests in order to situations where quests can break. Sorry for the inconvenience!
[*] Infinite scroll should no longer occur on menu screens.
[*] The one-day wait between the Make Yourself at Home and Friends & Family quests has been removed.
[*] Critter Lists no longer require tools in order to find them
[*] Pressing cancel when discussing Friendship Beads with Keroppi will cancel your purchase
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for February 4th
notes.content:
Hello Steam players! There is a new update available for you to download.
 This includes several minor fixes, as well as fixing:
Occasional loss of interaction when playing on Keyboard + Mouse or on Controller
You can download now by pressing the blue 'Update' button that took the place of your Play button. Happy adventuring!
